description: For an admin of a verified charity: who has joined an event's team and who is Ready (their phone or Garmin tested), as the charity's dashboard shows it. To remind those not Ready: first call with remind: true to get the number, ask the user "Remind the N?", and only after their yes call again with remind: true, confirm: true and count: N. Never send without that yes; once a day per event.

charity.description: The charity's livedot address or name, when they run more than one.

confirm.description: With remind: true only after the user said yes to reminding that number.

count.description: With remind and confirm: the number of people the user agreed to remind.

event.description: The event's name or id, or its link.

remind.description: Remind the team members who aren't Ready yet (upcoming events only).

name: my_charity_team

outputSchema.description: An event's team as the charity's dashboard shows it; a reminder only after the user's yes to the number.

app.description: The account's app (livedot for Good is on Windline).

can_remind.description: Whether a reminder can go today.

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong, in words for the user.

event.description: The event: { id, name, kind, start, tz, place, url, phase, joined }.

events.description: state pick: the charity's events to choose from.

fundraisers.description: Who joined: name, status, ready, km, support ({ kind, url, name }).

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user (no match, not live yet, a question back).

sent.description: After a confirmed reminder: how many were reminded.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: { label, url } to make a free Windline or RunFast account (?ref=mcp).

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

state.description: What happened: preview, made, changed, pick, list, confirm, sent, none, joined, already, link, saved, removed or name.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).
